column8: make delivery-enforce / proofbound sync all is RED: the reviews connector (kernel/internal/connector/reviews) rejects many committed verdicts — status ACCEPTABLE-WITH-NOTES (x2) and NEEDS_CHANGES (x9) are not in {ACCEPTABLE,NEEDS_WORK}, and several carry summary/verdict/id finding fields the connector forbids (only finding_id/severity/defect_commit). make check does NOT run delivery-enforce, so the LOCAL gate is green; but the governance gate cannot validate commit-intent bindings end-to-end until the pre-existing verdicts are brought into vera.verdict.v1 schema. My own 2026-11-09 verdicts conform. RESOLVED 2026-11-12 (R1-4, owner-required after R1-2 showed it blocks proofbound verify on a fresh clone): the 15 pre-schema verdicts were normalized to vera.verdict.v1 in commit 421938c — status synonyms mapped (ACCEPTABLE-WITH-NOTES->ACCEPTABLE; NEEDS_CHANGES/NEEDS-CHANGES->NEEDS_WORK), each finding reduced to the conformant {finding_id,severity[,defect_commit]} shape (info->LOW and low-medium->MED were the only severity remaps) with the complete original findings block preserved verbatim in-body and the self-digest recomputed; NEEDS_WORK verdicts keep >=1 finding. Proven on a clean-bootstrapped embedded ledger (migrate->sync intent all->sync git->sync reviews->verify): sync reviews malformed=0, sync all exit 0, verify exit 0. The reviews connector itself is the verifier (schema acceptance is objective); no non-author verdict required.
